description: This is project add ban if you death
body:
📜 DeathBan — Plugin Description
Here is a professional description for your plugin. You can use it for SpigotMC, Modrinth, GitHub README, or your server website.
⚔️ DeathBan
One life. One mistake. Game Over.
DeathBan is a hardcore-style plugin that permanently bans players upon death. Ideal for hardcore servers, survival challenges, and PvP arenas where every life counts.
✨ Features
Feature
Description
💀 Instant Ban
Player is banned immediately after death
🚫 Permanent Ban
Uses Minecraft's native ban system
🎨 Custom Messages
Colored kick and ban messages
📦 No Loot Drop
Items and XP do not drop on death
⚡ Lightweight
No config files, no dependencies (except Paper/Spigot)
🔧 Easy to Use
Install and forget — works out of the box
📥 Installation
Download DeathBan.jar
Place it in your server's plugins/ folder
Restart the server
Done! 🎉
🎮 Commands
Command
Permission
Description
/pardon <player>
minecraft.command.pardon
Unban a player
/banlist
minecraft.command.banlist
View banned players
⚠️ There are no plugin-specific commands. Bans are handled by Minecraft's native system.
🔐 Permissions
Permission
Default
Description
deathban.bypass
op
Bypass death ban (if implemented)
minecraft.command.pardon

🖥️ Requirements
